To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) ensemble-based data mining techniques are an important tool for intrusion detection; (2) the use of distributed approaches and collaborative IDSs are two of the most promising directions to design efficient and robust NIDSs; (3) the combination of ensemble-based data mining with distributed and collaborative approaches is the most promising direction for the design of efficient and robust NIDSSs.
ensemble based collaborative and distributed methods are the best choice to implement modern network intrusion detection systems.

(i) the most common ensemble-based data mining techniques used to build NIDS are the Bagging and the Boosting algorithms; (ii) the most common distributed ensemble-based data mining algorithms used to build NDSs are the Bagging, Boosting and the Distributed Random Forest algorithms; (iii) the most common collaborative IDSs are based on the Bagging and Boosting algorithms.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an ensemble of classifiers that can be applied to the intrusion detection problem in a distributed manner, with the objective to achieve high detection rates with low false positive rates.
the design and implementation of a distributed intrusion detection system based on ensemble-based machine learning techniques.

the design and development of a distributed intrusion detection system (DIDS), based on an ensemble of classifiers, that can be used to detect intrusions on a network of workstations, in a distributed environment.

Ensemble based data mining methods are a promising approach in the context of intrusion detection.

ensemble based collaborative and distributed systems are a very promising approach to design efficient NIDSs, able to handle large amounts of data in real-time, and to share knowledge across multiple nodes.
the current state of ensemble-based intrusion detection systems is still not satisfactory, but it is improving and it is a very promising research direction.

we are able to provide a comprehensive review for the ensemble-based intrusion detection system.
ensemble based collaborative and distributed IDS are a promising approach for modern network intrusion detection.
the ensemble-based methods are a very powerful and flexible approach to the intrusion detection problem.
The main takeaway from our work is that
ensemble-based data mining algorithms are a promising approach for the design and implementation of modern intrusion detection systems.

ensemble methods have been successfully used in NIDS, but they have been applied to the problem of network intrusion detection only in a few cases, and they have been used in a distributed environment in an even smaller amount of cases.
the ensemble-based data mining algorithms, in particular the distributed implementations, are a promising approach in the field of intrusion detection systems.
